description.p: Pictureshow plays the movies and shows on your own Jellyfin server. It's free and open source, with no ads and no tracking. It's a third-party app, not an official Jellyfin client, and you need your own Jellyfin server to use it.

ul.li: Finds Jellyfin servers on your home network, or connects to any address you type
Sign in with a password or Quick Connect, with several users and servers
Continue watching, Next up, your libraries and what's new
Plays files directly with mpv, so the server only converts what it has to
Watch together with friends, and control playback from your phone

description.p: Pictureshow is made by Legitimate LLC. The source code is at https://github.com/pictureshow/pictureshow
